# grantory_host (Data Source)
Use this data source to filter Grantory records inside a Terraform/OpenTofu plan.


## Schema

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host_id` (String) Identifier of the host to fetch. Exactly one of `host_id` or `unique_key` must be specified.
- `unique_key` (String) Unique key constraint used to enforce host uniqueness within a namespace. Exactly one of `host_id` or `unique_key` must be specified.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels attached to the host.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `public_key` (String) Ed25519 public key in hex format for signing requests.
